LanguageData.CBF_Pw_PickOne: Pick a pawn kind or pawn list on the left.
LanguageData.CBF_Pw_ProjectTip: Only pawn kinds and lists from the selected mod.
LanguageData.CBF_Pw_AllModsTip: Also pawn kinds from other mods. You can view them and copy them into your mod.
LanguageData.CBF_Pw_FromSelectionTip: Copies the pawn kind of the pawn selected on the map into your mod.
LanguageData.CBF_Pw_TechTip: The tech level decides which settlements this pawn appears in. It comes from the most advanced gear.
LanguageData.CBF_Pw_NoGearYet: No fixed gear yet. Turn off "hide empty" and click a free cell in the grid.
LanguageData.CBF_Pw_GridEmpty: The pawn wears nothing on this selection of body parts.
LanguageData.CBF_Pw_ExtraLevelsTip: Additional skill levels, spread at random.
LanguageData.CBF_Pw_MinTotalTip: All skill levels together reach at least this value.
LanguageData.CBF_Pw_MinBestTip: The best skill reaches at least this level.
LanguageData.CBF_Pw_NoFaults: No errors, same check as when the game loads.
LanguageData.CBF_Pw_RadiusTip: How far the pawns spread around their spot.
LanguageData.CBF_Pw_SwapTip: Replaces the piece with another one that fits the same layers. Material, quality and color stay where possible.
LanguageData.CBF_Pw_StageTip: The tech level this list counts as. "from gear" works it out from the weapons and apparel of each pawn kind. Set a level when the gear does not fit, for example tribal warriors with medieval leather who should appear in a tribal camp. The settlement then draws from the whole list without looking at the gear. The log warns when the level is above that of the settlement.
